notes:
Summary: Amberleaf (large EU healthcare SaaS) evaluating Redwood Private VPC for clinical-assistant and document-search workloads. Strong data residency requirement (EU-only), strict retention/archival controls (7+ years for audit artifacts), and KMS/HSM integration required. They have an internal Vendor Risk Management (VRM) process.

Key asks/requirements (CRM-style):
- Private VPC with customer-managed keys (KMS + CloudHSM/HSM) — must support key rotation and export-controls.
- Audit logging: full request/response audit trails for access reviews, ability to stream logs to customer SIEM (Splunk/Datadog) and store immutable log copies for min 7 years.
- Data residency: EU-only data plane and log residency; control plane can be Redwood-managed but must not store PII.
- Shared responsibility: vendor risk team wants explicit table showing who controls LLM prompts, KV/prefix caches, backups, and model artifacts.
- SIG/CAIQ: submitted on 2026-03-03; vendor asked for CAIQ mapping + architecture diagram + encryption key flow within 3 business days.
- SSO/SSO integration: Okta SAML expected; SCIM provisioning optional.
- Security certifications: SOC2 Type II report + ISO attestation requested; Redwood asked to provide latest reports and gap remediation timeline.

- 2025-11-04: Intro call (Maya + Carlos) — initial interest in Private VPC for clinical workflows.
- 2025-12-08: Architecture kickoff with infra team (FF-2025-12-08-002) — discussed network peering and egress controls.

- Security to prepare shared-responsibility matrix and architectural diagram showing key flows through HSM (ACTION: Carlos, due 2026-03-15).
